user.title: Connect Dreame lawn mower
user.description: Sign in with your Dreamehome or MOVAhome account to discover mower devices.

device.title: Select mower
device.description: Choose one mower to add. Run setup again to add another mower from the same account.

reauth.title: Reconnect account
reauth.description: Update your Dreamehome or MOVAhome credentials.

error.2fa_required: Two-factor authentication must be completed in the vendor app or website before setup can continue.
error.cannot_auth: The account login failed. Check the username, password, account type, and region.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach the Dreame or MOVA cloud. Check network access and try again.
error.invalid_account_type: The selected account type is not supported by this integration.
error.invalid_region: The selected region was rejected by the cloud. Check the account region used in the vendor app.
error.no_devices: No supported lawn mower devices were found for this account. Check that the selected region and account type match the vendor app.

abort.already_configured: All supported mowers on this account are already configured.

data_description.map_rotation: Fallback rotation for maps without a per-map selection. Use the Selected Map Display Rotation entity for individual maps.
data_description.map_theme: Choose a coordinated light, dark, midnight, or high-contrast palette for all locally rendered maps.
data_description.map_stroke_scale: Scale map boundaries and paths from 0.5 to 3.
data_description.map_marker_scale: Scale map points and the live mower marker from 0.5 to 3.
data_description.map_marker_image: Optional PNG, JPEG, or WebP inside Home Assistant's config/www folder, for example mower/marker.png or /local/mower/marker.png. Files outside that folder and files larger than 1 MB are ignored.
data_description.map_spot_area_style: Hide saved spot-mowing rectangles for a clean Dreame-like map, show only their outlines, or restore the filled diagnostic overlay. This affects locally rendered vector maps only.
data_description.map_mowing_path_style: Hide completed mowing passes, render them subtly, or show every pass in full detail. The live route and mower marker remain visible.
data_description.video_retention: Balanced gives snapshot previews a 60-second reconnect window and keeps XP2P ready for the current mowing run after someone opens live video. Battery saver always releases it shortly after the last consumer. Video priority also treats snapshot access as a reason to stay ready while mowing. All modes remain lazy until media is requested and stop when mower state blocks video.
data_description.video_transport: Auto is the fast default: it refreshes only mower safety state, then reuses health-checked provisioning and prefers a proven LAN route when firmware exposes one. Cloud remains the compatibility fallback. The tested A2 firmware does not expose Tencent's separate LAN service, so neither mode promises internet-independent startup.
data_description.xp2p_library_path: Advanced video option. Use a dynamic XP2P library built for this Home Assistant host OS and CPU. Android APK/AAR libraries and iOS frameworks are not host runtimes.
data_description.xp2p_runner_command: Advanced video option. Use only a local host runner that owns a compatible XP2P runtime and returns a local FLV URL. Android helpers are not the intended Home Assistant runtime.
data_description.xp2p_runner_mode: Use process mode for a runner that stays alive while Home Assistant streams.
